entries.text: The facility is essentially wired, and only accessible via a datajack from it's HQ (where all recordings are). The Matrix of the Facility is a [Rating] Agent on a computer that is equivalent of a Rating [commlink] security commlink that protects the icons with [IC][andMatrix], and of course Patrol. Sensor feeds are sent to the Agent, conglomerated, and dispatched to the sentry or guard jacked in in the HQ. The guard then dispatches his teammates, drones, or spirits via short range radio. This is done for security reasons, making hacking the site nigh impossible, because to control or spoof the guards you have to be in the HQ.
